production_probe.method: A private read-only host wrapper called the existing exit_pvr_pair, exec_loader, consumers and kui_vmu_native_patch_no_interiors implementations against the supplied startup. No image bytes were changed.

observed_operations_before_bootstrap: Updates FPSCR and replaces the stack pointer.
Clears the BSS interval beginning at 0x8c3aba60 (the startup image end) and ending at 0x8c4d7420.
Calls 0x8c16be28, then invokes the bootstrap target.
extra_consumer.note: The lack of an aligned literal reference alone cannot prove this startup-shaped path unreachable; direct, interior and computed entry paths need separate treatment.

conclusion: PSO already matches the complete reviewed PVR exit pair and executable loader. Its additional encoded bootstrap consumer is why complete exit discovery refuses the image. Keep that refusal: accepting only the existing three entries would leave the extra lifetime path uncovered.
next_work: Determine the enclosing startup path's actual reachability and lifetime from the executable entry and dispatch machinery.

If reachable, prove a terminal entry before its state-changing operations and carry that additional entry through cache validation, stage installation and runtime witnesses. The present exit descriptor supports at most three entries.
Do not treat a patch at the final BIOS call, or the absence of a direct pointer to the enclosing entry, as a complete lifetime proof.
